preferences.name: baseUrl
preferences.title: LiteLLM Base URL
preferences.description: Base URL of the LiteLLM proxy, without a trailing slash.

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: LiteLLM API Key
preferences.description: Virtual key issued by the LiteLLM proxy. Stored in Raycast's encrypted preference store.

preferences.name: defaultModel
preferences.title: Default Model
preferences.description: Model group used when a command has no override. Leave empty to pick on first run.

preferences.name: requestTimeout
preferences.title: Request Timeout
preferences.description: Seconds to wait for the proxy before failing.

preferences.name: chatHistoryMessages
preferences.title: Chat Memory Messages
preferences.description: How many prior messages to send as context in Chat.

preferences.name: resultViewInput
preferences.title: Input Source
preferences.description: Where text-transformation commands read their input from.

preferences.name: resultViewInputFallback
preferences.title: Enable Input Source Fallback
preferences.description: When the preferred input source is empty, read from the other one instead.
preferences.label: Fall back to the other source when the preferred one is empty

preferences.name: agentMaxIterations
preferences.title: Agent Iteration Limit
preferences.description: How many tool rounds the agent may take before stopping.

preferences.name: agentWriteTools
preferences.title: Enable Writing Tools
preferences.description: Allow the agent to write files, paste text and run shell commands. Reading is unaffected.
preferences.label: Let the agent change things, not just read them

preferences.name: agentShellAllowlist
preferences.title: Shell Allowlist
preferences.description: Comma-separated commands the agent may run, e.g. ls,git,rg. Empty disables the shell entirely.
